task: Owner request: an OSS updates menu and process for the IDP portal, scoped to a status view plus a request flow. The portal never changes the cluster; the upgrade still goes PR -> independent review -> GitOps. Declared versions come from VERSIONS.md via a committed generated snapshot, running versions from Argo CD and Trivy (existing portal access), upstream latest from an opt-in public GitHub lookup that is off by default (air-gap). The request flow generates issue text with the narwhal-version-upgrade checklist (no tracker credential in this change) and records an audit event. High-risk paths touched: .github/workflows/version-check.yml (one added sync-check step and two path filters) and .agents/skills/narwhal-version-upgrade/SKILL.md. No live cluster was available; live verification is listed, not claimed.

events.summary: Add a read-only Settings tab (cluster-admin gate shared with every Settings tab) and one POST that only generates issue text and writes an audit event. Deliberately left alone: RBAC and the chart (Argo CD and Trivy are already read by the portal), every credential (no GitHub/Gitea token is read or required), Dependabot config, check-version-consistency.sh, the live cluster, and the portal's GitOps pin. The only workflow change is one extra step in version-check.yml running node portal/scripts/gen-oss-versions.mjs --check, plus the two paths that feed it, so a VERSIONS.md-only PR cannot desync the snapshot.

No portal surface shows declared vs running vs upstream versions, cooling, or a request path; version bumps start from ad-hoc research and the 7-day cooling rule lives only in a lockfile script and skill prose. The portal image builds from portal/ alone, so it cannot read VERSIONS.md at runtime.

Implemented: generator + committed JSON with --check (D: committed snapshot over runtime read); status service joining catalog, Argo targetRevision, Trivy image tags/CVEs and optional GitHub releases (flag OSS_UPDATES_UPSTREAM, default off, failures cached 10 min as unknown, 6 h on success); cooling gate (409) and idempotent request (14 day Valkey claim) with an oss.update.request audit operation; KO/EN i18n; process doc linked from the skill and the tab.

events.scope: portal unit/route/component tests for version math, air-gap no-egress, upstream failure degradation, auth gates, validation, cooling, idempotency and audit; i18n parity and cache-key contract tests; generated-JSON sync test
evidence: test:cd portal && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build -> pass

events.scope: Rendered the tab in a local next dev with AUTH_MOCK (browser, Playwright/Chromium): mocked connected data (cooling, drift, held minor, major gap), the real API in air-gap mode (24 rows, every upstream/running/CVE cell unknown, page usable), and the request dialog replaying a duplicate. NOT covered: a real cluster (Argo CD application list, Trivy reports), GitHub lookup against the real API from a connected cluster, Valkey-backed idempotency across replicas, a screen reader pass.

events.summary: A cluster-admin can see declared/running/upstream state with cooling and gaps, and generate an audited, de-duplicated upgrade request; nothing mutates the cluster, and with upstream lookup off the page degrades to unknown.
Complete and verified locally; live-cluster data sources, connected upstream lookup and token mode remain unverified/unimplemented.
